description: Cotejo citation check for agents. POST /v1/check {items:[{url, quote?, cited_at?}]} (1-10 items). Per item: is the page alive, is the quote on it (exact/near/partial, token-normalised, excerpt), and if not, did the Wayback Machine copy closest to cited_at contain it. Verdicts: supported, weak, not_found, drifted, dead_archived, dead_unverified, dead, alive, unchecked, rejected; each with http status, final URL, SHA-256 of fetched bytes and archive_status. No LLM; results reflect the live web at call time. POST /v1/match {text, quote} is a pure deterministic match. GET /v1/verdicts explains every label. Every response is a JSON object.

rpc_types.backend_hint: cotejo Node HTTP server on :8080; POST /v1/check, POST /v1/match, GET /v1/health, GET /v1/version.
rpc_types.notes: Inputs in the POST body only. Bad input is JSON 400; an unreachable cited page is a result (verdict dead), never a 5xx.

specs.notes: Request and response shapes with examples.

serving.backend: cotejo (Node 22+, no dependencies) container behind an HA RelayMiner rest backend. Fetches only public http(s) addresses on ports 80/443; every DNS answer and redirect is checked against private, loopback, link-local and metadata ranges.

body.text: Pocket Network relays paid API calls.

healthcheck.notes: Functional probe, no network access needed.
